entry.context:
The inner cylinder contains dry air plus water vapor at total pressure
approximately P_atm.  The water level is adjusted and its height H is recorded
as temperature T falls.  At T_0 = 273.15 K, extrapolated height is H_0 and the
water vapor pressure may be taken as zero.  Vapor pressure obeys
ln(P_v/P_v0) = -(Q_v/R)*(1/T - 1/T_0).  Use the experimental procedure and
geometry on pages 11--12.
entry.current_question: Convert Q_v into latent heat per unit mass L_v and state the formula.

previous_parts.question: Construct a Clausius-Clapeyron graph and use it to determine the molar latent heat Q_v.
previous_parts.answer: Plot ln(P_v/P_atm) against 1/T; official sample slope is -4700 +/- 200 K and Q_v = 39 +/- 2 kJ/mol.
reusable_conclusions: Plot ln(P_v/P_atm) against 1/T; official sample slope is -4700 +/- 200 K and Q_v = 39 +/- 2 kJ/mol.
